newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks climb strongly, near all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks climb strongly, near all-time high.

text.p: Madrid stocks were sharply higher at midday on Wednesday, having setting fresh all-time highs backed by favourable references on all sides, dealers said.

The prospect of a new influx of stock funds next week when a special government debt expires is still prompting expectations that the Ibex will head up to next resistance at 7,050. However Wall Street's volatile performance could instill some caution.
Spain's first quarter GDP, showing strong private consumption, was helping to push up retail firms, dealers said.
The general index rose 5.96 points, 1.01 percent to 598.04 and the Ibex gained 76.53 points, 1.13 percent, to 6,873.61.
Supermarkets Pryca and Continente were both up over three percent, bolstered by the GDP figures.
Tubacex, due to enter the Ibex-35 in July, was up 7.51 percent to 501 pesetas in heavy volume, having given a bright outlook at an analyst presentation, dealers said.
Endesa, which has its general shareholders' meeting today, rose 140 pesetas to 11,700.
Dealers said final investor interest was selective, and much of volume was accounted by trading.
Spanish GDP rose 2.9 percent year-on-year in the first quarter.
